author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices spotting repeats and mirror shapes, running and walking rhythms, verse and chorus on the keyboard map, and left-hand notes, using a silly marching song.

classes.title: Same start, four times
classes.goal: Set the hand on C and learn the first half, where every line starts the same.

mathTarget.parentLine: Every line of the verse begins with the same four notes

classes.parentPrompt: Clap each time a line starts with 'C, C, D, E'. You play the low G.
classes.childAction: Play C, C, D, E at the start of every line.
classes.bridge: C, C, D, E is the pony's trot: every line sets off the same way.

intro.caption: Every line starts the same
intro.parentCue: clap each time C, C, D, E comes

games.caption: Yankee Doodle went to town
games.parentCue: You play the low G right after

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting lines that start the same.

classes.title: Up to the feather and back
classes.goal: Learn the 'feather in his cap' line, which climbs up and comes straight back down.

mathTarget.parentLine: The notes climb up, then walk back down the same way

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's arm to the shoulder, then back down to the hand.
classes.childAction: Play C, D, E, F up, then F, E, D, C back.
classes.bridge: Climb up to the feather on F, then step back down the same stairs.

intro.caption: Up to the feather, back down
intro.parentCue: walk your fingers up and down their arm

games.caption: Stuck a feather in his cap
games.parentCue: Say one, one, two, three, four, three, two, one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a tune that goes up and mirrors back down.

classes.title: The chorus lives higher
classes.goal: Move the hand up to G and learn the chorus, which lives higher on the keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: The chorus moves to the right, where the notes are higher

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child slide the thumb from C up to G, five keys to the right.
classes.childAction: Thumb on G, then play the chorus up high.
classes.bridge: The verse trots on the low road; the chorus rides up the hill.

intro.caption: Slide up to G
intro.parentCue: help the thumb move five keys right

games.caption: Yankee Doodle, keep it up
games.parentCue: Say two, three, two, one, two, three, four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving the hand higher for the chorus.

classes.title: Low verse, high chorus
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear the low verse, then the high chorus.

mathTarget.parentLine: A story part down low, then a chorus part up high

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch a little for the verse and sit up tall for the chorus.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; sit up tall when the chorus starts.
classes.bridge: Verse on the left, chorus on the right: the song has two neighbourhoods.

intro.caption: Low verse, high chorus
intro.parentCue: sit up tall together for the chorus

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a verse and a chorus in order.

classes.title: Run-ning, run-ning, walk
classes.goal: Practise 'Yankee Doodle dandy' slowly: four running notes, then two walking notes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two running notes take the time of one walking note

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning, run-ning, walk, walk' and clap it once before your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play the run-ning notes quick, the walk notes slower.
classes.bridge: Yan-kee Doo-dle runs like a pony; dan-dy walks, proud and slow.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick notes and walking notes, two to one.

classes.title: Pony hooves, low and steady
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note, then three waits: clop, two, three, four

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'clop, two, three, four' aloud; your child plays the low note on every 'clop'.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays low C or low G on every 'clop'.
classes.bridge: Low notes on the left are the pony's hooves: clop, two, three, four.

intro.caption: Clop, two, three, four
intro.parentCue: say it aloud as you play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one low note at the start of each bar.

classes.title: Rider and pony, slowly
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Both hands share one beat, each with its own job

classes.parentPrompt: Count very slowly and tap your child's left hand at the start of each bar.
classes.childAction: Left hand clops once, right hand plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the pony; the right hand is the rider singing.

intro.caption: Rider and pony, slowly
intro.parentCue: tap their left hand at each bar's start

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands with different jobs, slowly.

classes.title: From trot to canter
classes.goal: Play both hands together closer to full speed, keeping the beat even.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same notes and order, only a little quicker

classes.parentPrompt: If the hands tangle, smile and say 'back to a trot'; speed comes last.
classes.childAction: Play both hands a bit faster; slow to a trot if it tangles.
classes.bridge: The pony speeds up from a trot to a canter, hooves still even.

intro.caption: Trot, then canter
intro.parentCue: go back to slow if it tangles

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping the beat even at a faster speed.

classes.title: Ride into town
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: March your feet beside your child and sing; if they slip, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep riding after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is the road into town; you ride along without stopping.

intro.caption: Ride into town!
intro.parentCue: march your feet beside your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: A feather for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy: a gentle verse, then a big proud chorus.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing one part softer and the next part louder

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the chorus big and proud, then cheer and bow.
classes.childAction: Play softly for the verse, proudly for the chorus, then bow.
classes.bridge: The verse trots quietly into town; the chorus waves a proud feather.

intro.caption: A silly march for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one part softer, one part louder.
